audience: podcasters and podcast teams who run shows, episodes and playlists on Ausha

useCases.title: List shows and their seasons
useCases.text: List the shows this token can access. Then list the seasons of one show, with the podcast count in each season.

useCases.title: Find draft and scheduled episodes
useCases.text: List the episodes of a show, filtered by status: active, draft or scheduled. Open one episode to read its details.

useCases.title: Review the ad campaigns of a show
useCases.text: List the ad campaigns of a show with their state, dates and listen limits. Open one campaign for its details.

useCases.title: Read a playlist in episode order
useCases.text: List the playlists of a show with their privacy and episode count. Open one playlist to see its episodes in order.

useCases.title: Build a playlist and order its episodes
useCases.text: Create a playlist in a show, then add episodes to it. Move an episode to a new position in the playlist.
